name: t0/greedy
why:
Greedy, on BOTH arms, so the pair is single-variable -- which it remains, and which is why the arm is still reported as clean. But the evidence that SELECTED greedy was unrepresentative, and this field is the record of that, so it says both halves.

WHAT THE PROBE SAID. Six probes, one per category, greedy thinking at the real budget of 32000 (tuning below the run's budget is what hid the Qwen3.5 and GLM spirals): 0/6 capped, 0/6 no-answer, every one finish_reason=stop with an answer -- hpy-001 5104 tok, hjs-001 31085, hts-001 21170, hsql-001 2627, hsh-001 6868, hgit-001 13397, at ~60 tok/s. Read straight, that says greedy terminates here where it spirals on Qwen3.5, GLM 4.7 and Gemma 4 12B.

WHAT THE RUN SAID. It does not. At 25/104 of the real thinking arm the counters read capped 6, no-answer 6, and the last 30 generations had 8 sitting at 31900-31980 tokens with a median of 21038. About a quarter of hard-tier tasks lose the entire 32000-token budget to reasoning and return nothing.

WHY THE PROBE MISSED IT. It took the FIRST task of each category, which is a convenience sample, not a hard one -- the same failure hardtemp.py's own docstring records ('the earlier sampling sweep ranked configs on a probe set that was mostly trivial, so it was ranking noise'). The warning was visible and under-weighted: hjs-001 stopped at 31085 of 32000, within 915 tokens of the cap, on a six-task sample. One probe that close to the ceiling is a distribution touching it, not a distribution clearing it.

WHY GREEDY IS KEPT ANYWAY. The alternative is a hotter thinking arm against a greedy off arm, which is the exact confound that inflated Gemma 26B from +22 to +28, or a presence_penalty brake, which would have to be applied to BOTH arms and re-run from scratch to stay single-variable. Non-termination on a quarter of tasks is a real property of this model at greedy, not an artefact to sample away, and the honest number is the clean one with its cap count reported beside it. The score is a floor on the model's reasoning ability, not an estimate of it.

B3 CAVEAT. b3's reasoning floor is 8000, not 32000, and traces of this length will bind on most b3 thinking tasks. The floor stays at 8000 because every other model on that suite was measured there; changing it for one model would break the comparison rather than improve it.

arm_switch.why: Probed, not assumed. On this GGUF build reasoning_effort=none genuinely suppresses reasoning (0 characters of reasoning_content, against 1397 at baseline), so the OFF arm is really off. Every chat_template_kwargs form -- enable_thinking true and false, thinking false -- returns output byte-identical to baseline, i.e. silently ignored. The graduated scale is inert too: reasoning_effort=low and =medium are byte-identical to sending nothing, so only 'none' is honoured and the ON arm sends nothing (the model's own default). That is the opposite of Qwen3.8, whose ON arm had to name an effort because its default was xhigh. Note this contradicts the repo's earlier shorthand that reasoning_effort is ignored on GGUF: that was measured on Qwen3.8's GGUF build. The knob's portability is per-model, not per-backend, which is why it is probed per model.
